mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_sessions (id, workspace_id, knowledge_base_id, user_id, title) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{userId}, #{title})
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_messages SET status = #{status}, content = #{content}, error_code = #{errorCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{messageId} AND role = 'ASSISTANT' AND status = 'STREAMING'

UPDATE chat_messages SET status = 'INTERRUPTED', content = #{content}, error_code = 'CLIENT_CANCELLED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND id = #{messageId} AND role = 'ASSISTANT' AND status = 'STREAMING'
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM chat_messages WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND id = #{messageId} AND role = 'ASSISTANT'
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_sessions SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{sessionId}

UPDATE chat_messages SET status = 'INTERRUPTED', error_code = 'SERVER_RESTARTED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND role = 'ASSISTANT' AND status = 'STREAMING' AND updated_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
mapper.select: SELECT id, turn_id, role, status, content, error_code, created_at FROM chat_messages WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY created_at, id

SELECT ordinal, chunk_id, document_id, document_version_id, document_name, sequence_number, CAST(source_position AS text) AS source_position, excerpt, similarity FROM message_citations WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND message_id = #{messageId} ORDER BY ordinal
